text: 美国非农与PCE数据将发布，考验美联储加息路径；中国PMI、澳洲联储决议同步来袭；OpenAI开发者大会、特斯拉Roadster亮相、SpaceX星舰试飞、谷歌TPU卫星发射、美光财报密集登场；特朗普拒绝伊朗停火方案，霍尔木兹谈判生变，油价与地缘风险交织；国庆期间，A股10月1日至7日休市。 <u>9月28日(周一)：</u> 07:50 日本央行7月货币政策会议纪要 09:30 中国8月规模以上工业企业利润 15:00 国新办就落实“十五五”规划、推动中央企业高质量发展举行发布会 中国央行将在9月28日至10月8日开展隔夜逆回购操作，每日操作量不超过1
text_en: US nonfarm payrolls and PCE data will be released, testing the Fed's rate hike path; China PMI and the RBA decision arrive at the same time; OpenAI DevDay, Tesla Roadster unveiling, SpaceX Starship test flight, Google TPU satellite launch, and Micron earnings take the stage in quick succession; Trump rejects Iran's ceasefire proposal, Hormuz talks shift, oil prices intertwine with geopolitical risk; during the National Day holiday, A-shares will be closed from October 1 to 7. <u>Monday, September 28:</u> 07:50 Bank of Japan July monetary policy meeting minutes 09:30 China August industrial enterprise profits above designated size 15:00 State Council Information Office briefing on implementing the 15th Five-Year Plan and promoting high-quality development of central enterprises The PBOC will conduct overnight reverse repo operations from September 28 to October 8, with daily operation volume not exceeding 1
